# Copilot Instructions for Raki Distributor Website

## Project Overview
This is a **static website** for Distribuidora Raki Ltda., a wholesale distributor of artisanal products from southern Chile. The site serves as a digital product catalog targeting B2B customers with a rustic, artisanal aesthetic.

## Architecture

### Stack & Structure
- **Pure vanilla JavaScript** - No frameworks, no build process, no bundlers
- **Single-page application** with modal overlays for products and contact
- Directly deployed to GitHub Pages via `.github/workflows/pages.yml`
- Spanish language throughout (all content, comments, and user-facing text)

### Key Files
- `index.html` - Main HTML with embedded critical CSS for performance (in `<style>` tag)
- `styles.css` - Additional styles (imported via `<link>` tag)
- `script.js` - All interactivity: carousel, modals, contact form, analytics
- `assets/` - Product images (WebP format), logos (PNG), carousel slides
- `.github/workflows/pages.yml` - GitHub Actions deployment workflow
- `CNAME` - Custom domain configuration (rakidistribuidora.cl)

## Development Patterns

### Styling Conventions
- **Font stack**: 'Playfair Display' (headings), 'Lora' (body) - artisanal serif aesthetic
- **Color palette**: 
  - Primary: `#2c6f4b` (forest green)
  - Accent: `#ff7a59` (coral/orange)
  - Background: `#f8f4ef` (warm cream)
  - Text: `#3e2f1c` (dark brown)
- **Responsive breakpoints**: 480px, 640px, 768px, 1024px (check both embedded CSS in `index.html` and `styles.css`)
- **Animation**: Intersection Observer for card fade-in (adds `.visible` class on scroll into view)

### JavaScript Architecture
- **Event-driven**: All interactions set up in single `DOMContentLoaded` listener at start of `script.js`
- **Modal system**: Shared overlay pattern for product details and carousel modal
  - Product modal: Opens on card click, displays image + details, updates WhatsApp FAB dynamically
  - Carousel modal: Opens when clicking carousel images for full-screen view
- **Carousel**: Touch-enabled with auto-play (5s interval), custom vanilla JS implementation
  - Functions: `goTo(index)`, `startAuto()`, `stopAuto()` (restarts on user interaction)
  - State: `current` index, `autoplay` interval handle, touch deltas (`startX`, `deltaX`)
- **Contact form**: EmailJS integration (service_ggzbnsk, template_7xaxazk) with fallback to `mailto:`
  - Collapsible section controlled by `.collapsed` class toggle

### Analytics Integration
- **Dual tracking**: Google Tag Manager (GTM-T7MQ65QT) + Google Analytics 4 (G-V14QD642ED)
- **Custom events**: Use `trackEvent()` function defined in `<head>` of `index.html`
- Events tracked:
  - Product clicks: `trackEvent('product_click', category, product_name, price)`
  - Carousel navigation: Fires on slide change via `goTo()` function
  - Form submissions: Fires on successful EmailJS send
  - Social media clicks: WhatsApp FAB interactions
  - Engagement: Deep scroll (500px+), time on site (30s, 60s)
- Example: `trackEvent('product_click', 'lacteos', 'queso_chanco', 3800)`

## Critical Workflows

### Adding Products
1. Add product card in appropriate `<section>` (lacteos, carnicos, gourmet, salsas)
2. Follow this structure:
```html
<article class="card" onclick="trackEvent('product_click', 'category', 'product_name', price)">
  <img src="./assets/image.webp" alt="Product name" loading="lazy" />
  <div class="card-content">
    <h3>Product Name</h3>
    <p>Description text.</p>
    <p class="price">Por mayor: $X.XXX</p>
  </div>
</article>
```
3. Product images are auto-wired to modals via event delegation - cards listen for clicks and extract image/title/description
4. Images must be in WebP format and placed in `assets/` directory

### Modifying Carousel
- **Structure**: Slides in `<div class="carousel-track" data-track>` container in `index.html`
- **Critical**: Number of slides MUST match number of indicator buttons in `.carousel-indicators`
- Carousel indicators are auto-generated by JavaScript on page load (script recreates them from slides)
- Auto-play interval: Search for `setInterval(() => goTo(current + 1)` in `script.js` (currently 5000ms)
- Touch gestures: Swipe threshold is 50px, configurable in `touchend` handler

### Contact Form Configuration
- **EmailJS Integration**: Service ID and Template ID at top of `script.js`
- Form validation: Checks name, email, and message fields (phone and category optional)
- Success behavior: Shows green checkmark, clears form, auto-closes after 2s
- Fallback: Opens `mailto:` link if EmailJS fails or is unavailable
- Email target: `raki.distribuidora.sur@gmail.com`

## Important Conventions

### Accessibility
- **ARIA attributes**: All interactive elements have proper labels and roles
- `aria-hidden` and `inert` used for collapsed sections (contact form, modals)
- Screen reader text: `.sr-only` class (visually hidden but accessible)
- Keyboard navigation: ESC closes modals, Enter/Space activates cards
- Focus management: Modals trap focus on close button, restore focus on close

### Image Optimization
- **WebP format** for all product images (except PNG logos)
- `loading="lazy"` on all images below fold
- Carousel images use `object-fit: cover` with `cursor: pointer` for modal trigger

### State Management
- **Carousel state**: `current` index variable (tracks active slide)
- **Modal open state**: `.open` class toggle + `aria-hidden` attribute sync
- **Contact form**: `.collapsed` class controls visibility with CSS transitions
- **Body scroll lock**: `overflow: hidden` applied to `<body>` when modals open
- **WhatsApp FAB**: `href` attribute updated dynamically based on context (product vs default)

### WhatsApp Integration
- **Footer social link** + **Floating Action Button (FAB)** for quick contact
- Dynamic message updates: Changes based on product selection in modal
- Default message: "Hola Raki 🌟, quiero información sobre sus productos"
- Product-specific: "Hola Raki 🌟, quiero información sobre: [Product Name]"
- Phone number: `56984131147` (Chile format)
- URL pattern: `https://wa.me/56984131147?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`

## Do NOT...
- Add build tools (Webpack, Vite, etc.) - site must remain static
- Change language to English - all content is in Spanish
- Remove Google Analytics tracking codes in `<head>` of `index.html`
- Use JavaScript frameworks - vanilla JS only
- Change email service without updating credentials and testing
- Modify the GitHub Actions workflow without understanding Pages deployment
- Add dependencies that require npm/node - this is a zero-dependency static site

## Common Tasks

### Update Prices
Search for `class="price"` in `index.html` and update values. Keep format: `Por mayor: $X.XXX`

### Add Carousel Slide
1. Add `<figure class="carousel-slide">` with `<img>` inside `.carousel-track` container
2. Add corresponding `<button type="button" data-slide="N">` in `.carousel-indicators` section
3. **Important**: Keep slide count and indicator count in sync (script auto-generates indicators but HTML has initial count)
4. Update `aria-label` attributes for accessibility

### Modify Contact Categories
Edit `<select id="contact-category">` options in contact form. Current categories:
- Lácteos (🧀), Embutidos y Cárnicos (🥓), Naturales y Gourmet (🍯), Salsas (🌶️), Consulta General (📦)

### Change Colors
Primary green: Search/replace `#2c6f4b`
Accent coral: Search/replace `#ff7a59`
**Note**: Colors defined in BOTH embedded CSS (`<style>` in `index.html`) AND `styles.css` - update both!

## Deployment
- **Automatic**: Push to `main` branch triggers GitHub Actions workflow
- **Workflow**: `.github/workflows/pages.yml` - simple artifact upload (no build step)
- **Process**: Checkout → Configure Pages → Upload entire repository → Deploy
- **Domain**: `rakidistribuidora.cl` (configured via `CNAME` file in root)
- **No build step** - files served as-is from repository root
- **Testing**: Local testing requires a simple HTTP server (e.g., `python -m http.server`)

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] Test carousel auto-play and touch gestures on mobile
- [ ] Verify contact form EmailJS submission (check spam folder)
- [ ] Check modal open/close with keyboard (ESC key)
- [ ] Validate analytics events fire (use browser console + GA debugger)
- [ ] Test responsive design at all breakpoints
- [ ] Verify images load with lazy loading
- [ ] Check WhatsApp link opens with correct message
- [ ] Verify carousel indicators match number of slides

## Troubleshooting

### Carousel Issues
- **Indicator mismatch**: If carousel indicators don't match slides, check that HTML indicators count equals slides count. Script auto-generates indicators from slide count.
- **Auto-play not working**: Verify `startAuto()` is called after `goTo(0)` in carousel initialization
- **Touch gestures unresponsive**: Check that deltaX threshold (50px) isn't too high for your use case

### Contact Form Issues
- **EmailJS not sending**: Check browser console for errors, verify service/template IDs are correct
- **Form doesn't close**: Success callback runs after 2s delay - check that `setContactOpen(false)` is defined
- **Validation failing**: Form requires name, email, and message (phone and category optional)

### Modal Issues
- **Images not loading**: Verify WebP format and correct path in `assets/` directory
- **Modal won't close**: Check that both close button AND overlay have click handlers
- **WhatsApp not updating**: Modal must call `openModal()` which updates WhatsApp FAB href

### Analytics Issues
- **Events not tracking**: Verify `typeof gtag !== 'undefined'` before calling tracking functions
- **Wrong data**: Check `trackEvent()` parameters match the signature: (eventName, category, label, value)
